authors: S. Dyubko, M. Efimenko, V. Efremov, S. Podnos
title: Microwave spectroscopy of S, P, and D states of sodium Rydberg atoms
method: atomic-beam microwave spectroscopy (53-350 GHz), two-step pulsed dye-laser excitation via 3P, selective field ionization
uncertainty: 'better than 50 kHz' for all frequencies (abstract); no per-line uncertainties
caveats: Only intervals; absolute positions need the nS quantum defects/ionization energy from other sources.
Rows 3, 4 (23S-23P) and 8 (25S1/2-25P1/2) deviate from the fit by an order of magnitude more than the others; authors could not identify the reason.
Fine-structure rows (Table III) are differences of Table I rows; do not use them together with Table I as independent data.
Values differ from Fabre et al. PRA 22, 778 (1980) by ~0.5-3 MHz for the same transitions; the authors attribute this to stray-field Stark shifts in the Fabre experiment.
Duplicate publication: do not combine with dyubko1995qe (same measurements).
